# Digits — Hardware Reference Photos

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `sangyn-2500-internals-base.jpg` | Base unit opened — overview of PCB, bells, wiring |
| `sangyn-2500-handset-exterior.jpg` | Handset exterior — sealed snap-fit design |

| `sangyn-2500-keypad-front.jpg` | Keypad PCB front with silicone dome membrane |
| `sangyn-2500-keypad-traces.jpg` | Keypad PCB with membrane removed — interleaved finger traces visible |
| `sangyn-2500-keypad-back.jpg` | Keypad PCB back — Bittel `HA(41)T-25 KB T1 V2.1`, ribbon connector |
| `sangyn-2500-main-pcb-back.jpg` | Main PCB solder side — through-hole, no SMD |
| `sangyn-2500-main-pcb-front.jpg` | Main PCB component side — relay, ICs, hook switch, connectors |
| `sangyn-2500-main-pcb-solder-side.jpg` | Main PCB close-up solder joints — hook switch pads visible |
